reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Cooperative association incorporation purposes and powers
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: 12 or more persons may form a cooperative association/society/exchange with corporate powers for goods, services, housing, or agricultural/mercantile business.

headings.title: Equivalence of cooperative entity terminology
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: 'association', 'company', 'corporation', 'society', and 'exchange' mean the same for § 357.010.

headings.title: Conversion of existing corporations to cooperatives
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: qualifying non-cooperative corporations may convert by articles amendment containing § 357.020 info, paying the § 357.060 new-cooperative fee.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 357.010 (bid 19345), all three subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 14406, A.L. 1985 S.B. 300; prior revisions 1919–1929). Retained all three titles.

headings.title: Meaning of housing cooperative
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: defines 'housing cooperative' as a chapter 357 cooperative (as modified by § 357.015) producing or furnishing housing.

headings.title: Minimum incorporators for housing cooperative
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: five or more persons may form a housing cooperative under § 357.010.

headings.title: Maximum shareholder ownership cap of twenty percent
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: caps any shareholder's ownership at 20% of aggregate par value of all stock for § 357.050 purposes.

headings.title: Bylaw business activities and joint operations
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 4: bylaws may specify business activities conducted independently or jointly with any other person, entity, or organization for § 357.130 purposes.

headings.title: Inapplicability of section 357.150 to housing cooperatives
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 5: § 357.150 does not apply to housing cooperatives.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 357.015 (bid 19346), all five subsections, and source note (L. 1998 S.B. 517). Retained all five titles.

headings.title: Incorporation fee schedule based on capital stock
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: $50 for first $50,000 or less of capital stock plus $5 per additional $10,000, paid to director of revenue; same capital-stock cap as other corporations.

headings.title: Fee waiver for Missouri National Guard and active duty military incorporators
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: waives sub 1 fees if signing incorporators include a Missouri-resident Missouri National Guard or active-duty military member providing proof to secretary of state.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 357.060 (bid 19351), both subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 14409, A.L. 1947, A.L. 2014 S.B. 600). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Board of directors management, election, and removal for cause
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: managed by >=5 directors elected by and from shareholders under bylaws; shareholders may remove any director for cause and fill vacancy at regular/special meeting.

headings.title: Executive officers, director status, and combined secretary-treasurer
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: annual director election of president, vice president(s), secretary, and treasurer (must be directors except secretary and treasurer, which may be combined).

headings.title: Vacancy filling upon director removal for cause
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: removal of a director for cause vacates any office held, to be filled from the reconstituted board after shareholders fill the director vacancy.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 357.080 (bid 19353), all three subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 14410; prior revisions 1919–1929). Retained all three titles.

headings.title: Net profit distribution: reserve funds, shareholder dividends, and patronage dividends
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: at least annual distribution (>=10% to reserve until 50% of paid-up capital, <=10% stock dividend, remainder as uniform patronage dividend); majority vote or written assent adopts bylaws.

headings.title: Permissible bylaw governance provisions
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2(1)-(8): meetings, quorums, proxy/mail voting, directors/officers, penalties/farm-org dues, 60-day stock deposit/book-value resale and lien rules, and business activities without enlarging statutory powers.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 357.130 (bid 19358), both subsections with subdivisions (1)-(8), and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 14417; prior revisions 1919–1929). Retained both titles.

headings.title: Eighty percent shareholder vote for voluntary dissolution and reincorporation
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 1: 80% stockholder vote to dissolve agricultural/mercantile corporation for cooperative reincorporation under §§ 276.160–276.230; certified copy of 'dissolution proceeds' sent to secretary of state.

headings.title: Secretary of state dissolution permit upon cooperative compliance
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 2: secretary of state issues dissolution permit effective upon cooperative incorporation compliance, requiring only 80% of shareholders to sign articles.

headings.title: Purchase of excess stock, asset conveyance, and assumption of liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Verified sub 3: board may buy stock >10% at book value; president/secretary convey all property and assets to new cooperative, which assumes all debts and claims.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read archived § 357.180 (bid 19363), all three subsections, and history notes (RSMo 1939 § 14420; prior revision 1929 § 12762). Noted source prints 'dissolution proceeds' in sub 1; retained all three titles.
